run_batch_process_encode_videos: run batch_process to encode all MP4 videos in a directory into latent embeddings using a Mochi VAE
embed_captions_with_t5: embed text captions into prompt embeddings using MochiPipeline's encode_prompt method with T5 text encoder
encode_single_video_to_latents: encode a single video file to compressed latents using AutoencoderKLMochi with shape validation and normalization
batch_process_with_overwrite: run batch_process with overwrite flag to re-encode existing video latents and caption embeddings
encode_videos_with_custom_shape: encode videos to latents with a custom T x H x W shape specification and frame trimming support
